title: Organizer
body:
The mod adds inventory sorting based on your template.

One button saves the template for how you want to sort.

The second button sorts the inventory, moving items to the appropriate slots.

There's a setting for the tick interval between moves.

The 15-second cooldown is built into the mod itself to prevent it from being used as an auto-totem or other cheating features (but even this doesn't guarantee that the mod will be legal on certain servers, so it's best to check with the admins).

You also need Fabric API and Mod Menu.
